_comment: Copy this file to config.json next to AutoDoc.exe and fill in the fields below. config.json is gitignored on purpose — never commit real API keys. Regenerated 2026-07-27 from config.py::_DEFAULTS; if you add a config key, update this file too.
_provider_comment: provider: 'anthropic' uses the Claude API (needs api_key + claude_model below). 'local' uses any OpenAI-compatible local vision server (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio) — narration and screenshots never leave the machine/network. Switching providers requires no code changes. A local model needs a paired mmproj projector to do vision at all.
_screenshot_comment: screenshot_mode is a RENDER setting, not a capture setting — screenshots are always stored raw, so this is changeable per session after the fact in the session editor. 'raw' | 'blurred' (privacy blur outside a clear circle at the click) | 'circled' (red ring at the click).
_output_comment: output_formats: any subset of md/html/docx. The first entry is what the 'Saved:' dialog offers to open.
_hotkey_comment: Global hotkeys, active only while recording. pynput GlobalHotKeys syntax; empty string disables one. Avoid ctrl+shift+p — that opens the print dialog in browsers and Office, which is exactly where workflows get recorded.
_bookstack_comment: BookStack publishing (v1.3). When enabled, Generate also pushes a markdown page with inline screenshots to bookstack_book. The bot token is NOT a setting here on purpose — it lives in its own file (see publish/token.py), because this whole file is rewritten from memory whenever the Settings tab saves, which would wipe a credential stored here.
_bookstack_tag_comment: Tag defaults, validated against publish/tags.py's controlled vocabulary — an unrecognised value is dropped, not passed through, so a typo costs one tag rather than splitting a BookStack filter. Empty string skips a tag. Status is always 'draft' on publish and is not configurable.
